newsitem.title: USA: Possis sees FDA ok on Perma-Seal in summer.
newsitem.headline: Possis sees FDA ok on Perma-Seal in summer.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc said Wednesday it expects to file a revised application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its Perma-Seal Dialysis Access Graft and expects clearance in summer.
Possis said it will file the application, a 510(k), in April. It said a number of companies have expressed an interest in marketing the product, and it is evaluating distribution alternatives.
Earlier, Possis, which provides medical devices for cardiovascular and vascular treatment markets, reported a second quarter loss of $0.08 a share versus a loss of $0.13 a share last year.
Total revenues rose to $1.91 million, compared with $236,268. Possis said the revenues increase was primarily the result of a settlement in of a distribution agreement.

The company received FDA clearance in December for its AngioJet System and has seen "good interest" in the product. It said the company posted U.S. AngioJet System diposable product sales of $90,000 in the second quarter and one month into third quarter has already surpassed that number.
